reviews.author: Annamaria “Mia” Vivar
reviews.text: I used JD Auto for years, but my last experience was extremely disappointing. I paid $2,000 for exhaust and AC work and explicitly asked for a safety check on my brakes before a major move with a significantly longer commute to work, only to be told they were completely fine. After picking up my Jeep, I noticed the steering wheel started shaking on the highway and the brakes made a loud thumping noise, issues that were not present before. To top it off, the car was returned covered in wood dust with a new scratch on the body. While they initially offered to look at the brakes and fix the scratch, their communication completely fell apart. I replied twice to set up a time to bring the car back and was ignored both times. After moving, my new mechanic immediately caught that I needed brand-new rotors. Brakes are a critical safety issue, and missing bad rotors during a requested safety check is unacceptable. It saddens me to leave a bad review for a shop I used to trust, but I was left with an unsafe car and ghosted when I tried to get it resolved.

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.text: Beyond grateful to James and the team at JD Automotive! I came in needing rear brakes and wanted the assurance that OEM-quality parts would be used. Even though the shop was fully booked until after Labor Day, James empathized with my situation and told me to drop off my car - promising it would be serviced the very same day. And he delivered! JD Automotive had been highly recommended to me, and now I see why. This family-owned shop truly takes care of its customers, and I’ll be happy to return for future service. Plus, Reese, the 2-year-old pup, who comes to work everyday, makes the visit even better!

reviews.author: Joe Petrillo
reviews.text: Been going to JD Automotive for 7 or 8 years. James and the whole team are top-notch! Their communication is excellent, and the quality of their work is always superb. Over the years, they’ve worked on every car I’ve owned, handling everything from routine oil changes and alignments to complex timing chain jobs on European cars. They’re always extremely honest and communicative about what needs immediate attention and what can wait. Their quotes are fair and accurate, both in terms of cost and timing. Plus, they provide very thorough insight into the work being done and explain issues in a way anyone can understand.

reviews.author: Lauren Spendley
reviews.text: I found this place through the AAA app when my car had to be towed. I knew nothing about the business except that they were in contract with AAA. When I called, I spoke with a very nice woman who who gave me information and reassurance. When I arrived, I met the son of the owner who seems to pretty much run the show. He was extremely polite and organized. I needed my tires replaced after 2 blew out. They were able to get me in and out within less than 24 hours. There was some wait time the day after my car was dropped off (anticipated it would be done at 8:30, but it did not get done until 11:30), BUT THIS WAS NOT NECESSARILY THEIR FAULT. There was an issue when they did the alignment which had to do with my car-NOT THE STAFF. They also comped my alignment to apologize for the wait time! Everyone there, including the mechanics, were pleasant and friendly and walked around with a smile on their faces. It was such a refreshing sight! I love that the owner's son brings his adorable and sweet dog to the shop as well! It made my wait time more enjoyable. I should also mention that they were reasonably priced and did not try to sell me on things I didn't need. A really positive experience and I plan to recommend them and use them again in the future!! THANK YOU FOR EVERYTHING!

reviews.author: Russell
reviews.text: My local AAA website recommended this amazing automotive and truck business and I could not be happier with the work performed. James and his team made a great first impression. They clearly explained the services needed, recommended, and then provided. Communications in person and over the phone were clear and timely. James is friendly, honest, knowledgeable, and trustworthy. I am grateful that I found his business and will continue to bring my cars to him when they need service. I highly recommend J.D. Automotive and Truck to anyone who needs their automobiles and trucks serviced, including a vehicle safety inspection. Thank you!

reviews.author: Logan LaTray
reviews.text: My car broke down on I-80 heading toward the city. I lucked out that it broke down where it did because JD Automotive & Truck was the closest shop. These guys were awesome! Got my car in and fixed right away when I needed it most. Was able to make my family reunion just in time thanks to them going out of their way on a Saturday to pick up the part I needed. Above and beyond! Hope I never break down in Dover like that again. But I know where to go if I do.

reviews.author: Ish Forbes
reviews.text: One thing I like about a bad day is a smooth transaction. lol. After having a blowout on the highway on my way to work AAA recommended them so I gave these guys a call and they got it done. Great customer service from beginning to end. I got a tire that fit my budget and needs. Thanks for being that one bright light at the end of the tunnel on my annoying day!!!!

reviews.author: Mark Anthony Carvalho
reviews.text: Our company, ServiceMaster by Timeless, was looking for an honest, customer-friendly car and truck service for our Fleet of vehicles, which was hard. We tried several different shops in the area and finally found JD Automotive! I’m Grateful to God that we found James and his team of Professional Technicians. They go above and beyond to service their customers' vehicles. Don’t let the word Truck in the name fool you; they service All Vehicles and really know what they are doing. The office and shop are clean, and that speaks a lot about how they care for your vehicle. I can’t say enough about James, Karen, and their Team of True Professionals Don’t take it from me; try them out for yourself. You won’t be disappointed. Thank You, JD Automotive and Truck!!!

reviews.author: Paul Schulze
reviews.text: In need of a good diesel mechanic, a coworker referred me to JD Auto & Truck, and I am so glad he did. I have been a customer of theirs for several years now, and I wouldn’t trust my vehicle with anyone else. James and the staff are fantastic! It’s refreshing to find a repair shop that is trustworthy and does great work!

reviews.author: Sohne Towing
reviews.text: After bringing my truck multiple places for an AC issue and no solutions. I came to J D and dropped it off. Customer service was excellent and James J.R assured me they will figure it out. After only 3 hours they had found the problem. I can’t thank them enough for fixing the issue. They had my truck back to me in 2 days total. Don’t even get me started on the price. I was SHOCKED with how affordable it was. Make them your first option. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Neal Gordon
reviews.text: Once again, JD Automotive did a great job on my 2017 VW Tiguan - better than my local dealer. Always a fair price and they don't try to do unnecessary work. Best of all, they do it right the first time.

reviews.author: Garrett Mcbride
reviews.text: I had to take my wife's car to be serviced for an AC issue today. Called the dealer that we purchased the vehicle and they wanted $200 just to run diagnostics on the car. After doing research I found J D Automotive & Truck with good google reviews. It was easy to make an appointment with them. I was called once my service was done so we could pick up the car with the issue resolved in only 2 hours. They also did an oil change after initial service was done per my request. Staff comes across and polite and professional. The prices are reasonable and fair for the work that is being done. Hopefully we do not have any need to return to any garage for service any time soon but if we do I would bring my car back here again.

reviews.author: Frank Childs
reviews.text: JD Auto and Truck provides reliable, great service. I know, when I make an appointment, they aren't going to try and sell me something I don't need. I can trust them and that's important to me. Their waiting room is humble, but they offer coffee and they have wifi. If your repair is going to take a while, they can offer you a local ride so you can avoid hanging out there all day. Bottom line is they're friendly, honest, hard working auto mechanic's who know what they're doing and isn't that what we're all looking for?

reviews.author: Diane Czochanski
reviews.text: My company vehicle is serviced here. Make an appointment for service. James will set your appointment up and answer any questions you have when you call. The front office has seating and keep very clean. They will advise any additional work needed to make sure your vehicle is road ready. Call them and you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Mike Burness
reviews.text: JD Automotive was truly a top notch experience and organization. They were up front about what was needed, were spot on with estimates provided beforehand, and were openly transparent about what we could and should expect. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for an automotive repair / maintenance partner.

reviews.author: Terence McKenna
reviews.text: Three Cheers for J.D. Locomotive. They were not my first choice for performing a state inspection. But the business I picked was unable to honor the appointment. I picked MotorPro Auto Repair because they were closer to my house. But when they failed, I drove to J.D. and made an appointment for the very next day - today. I arrive at 12:58pm for my 1:00pm appointment. They were clearly busy (they repair trucks too) and so I felt like small potatoes. Still by 1:45 I had paid my bill - the inspection was done, and they even replaced a brake light. This business clearly is busy (and so successful) but they were attentive and kept their promise. So... if not committed to dealer service because of a warranty, I suggest you give them a try.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Marcano
reviews.text: A God Send. They were able to repair our vehicle with fair pricing and a timely manner. They do get busy so be sure to setup an appointment with them asap. You won't regret it! Thank you again. :)

reviews.author: Melissa Madavi
reviews.text: What a great experience. We went in on a Saturday and asked to have my car inspected and found my forever place. While there, I overheard a customer explain that she needed $1200 in repairs, as told by another mechanic. The kind owner said he fixed the issue with a $4.00 part. It made me warm and fuzzy inside because you don’t see that kind of honesty these days.

reviews.author: Anoop Krishna Ramaswamy
reviews.text: If you at all have a heavy duty diesel truck and need work done to the specifics you provided, look no further. You know how hard it is to get a shop to do custom work on a vehicle to your specifications. These guys can think and problem solve, just not throw the wrench in the air and say, nope can't be done. If humans built it, you can fix it. That's the vibe i get from them. Are they cheap, definitely not. Do they do a great job and provide a fair value, A resounding yes. They are professional, upfront and courteous. Take your vehicle to them and get it done right the first time. Spend once, cry once... And they stand up for their work. I had to go back for an issue on my 1997 Ford diesel van and they fixed it on their dime. Gold standard in NJ

reviews.author: Robert Caston
reviews.text: I have to say that Nick and his crew were just fantastic. I asked them to check out a vehicle for me and they were a) very thorough b) very honest. These guys seem very sharp and trustworthy and I would definitely recommend them!!!! Also, you could tell his crew members were hard workers and took pride in what they did. You don't see that at too many auto places these days, especially the chain auto repair places.

reviews.author: Rachel Allyn
reviews.text: My dad has been a client of J.D. Automotive for over about 20 years and it continues to be the only facility I'll take my car to. The staff are super friendly and incredibly qualified, the work is high quality, and you can expect an honest and thorough assessment of your vehicle. I have and will continue to recommend J.D. Automotive to family and friends.

reviews.author: Solomon Steinman
reviews.text: My 2004 Honda Oddysey broke down on the highway, and I had it towed to JD Auto. Although it needed a new transmission and I decided to junk the car, they were very pleasant to deal with and they were very nice about me leaving my car in their lot for a few days until it got picked up. I would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: lionel geltman
reviews.text: Brought car in for a wheel alignment. Told me how long to perform and completed as planned. Staff very friendlyand helpful. Could not have had a better experience . Will definitely come again for other car services.

reviews.author: Kat F
reviews.text: Everyone here is very knowledgeable, they have state of the art facility. Plus all of their mechanics are highly experienced with top certifications. Their front desk Nick is very patient and friendly. They can find any problem and you can trust everyone here to make sure your vehicle is in the best hands possible.

reviews.author: Jason .C
reviews.text: Great place, James was especially helpful and re-assuring, the work was excellent, and the service was friendly, knowledgeable, honest and professional. They are now the only mechanic I trust to work on my vehicle.

reviews.author: RCS
reviews.text: JD Automotive was very professional from the start. I was able to drop off my van and enjoy my vacation while they worked on my Mercedes Sprinter engine and even managed to get me an extra key made..something my own Mercedes dealer couldn't do..just amazing service. -Mark Salazar RCS CONTRACTING LLC.

reviews.author: Donald Bieler
reviews.text: Truck broke Monday, snowed Tues was patient because of weather and picked up truck Thurs. Quick turnaround and very reason price on such short notice. If ever in a jam bring your stuff here James will treat you right.

reviews.author: schwartzy business
reviews.text: Car broke down on the interstate highway traveling back to New York. Long story short, I needed a camshaft sensor and JD automotive took care of me right away knowing I live in New York, currently traveling and my repair is a priority and for that I really appreciate you guys. Thanks again for the great and speedy service! Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Brian Considine
reviews.text: I took my car to these people after an electrical problem caused it to behave very erratically. This is the type of thing most driveway mechanics cannot handle and even many shops don't have the skill or equipment to figure out. They were able to get it done in just a day and track down the individual wires that were causing the trouble. They did this without charging outrageous fees and they were in touch throughout the repair. Of course they were also very polite and clean. Top notch work. If you have any trouble I would seek them out

reviews.author: Mendoza Tops & Tile
reviews.text: Everyone at JD Automotive is great. We have been taking our personal cars and our business trucks and Sprinters for over two years. The customer service is fantastic!

reviews.author: Cole M
reviews.text: My car came back to me better than ever. I had no issues at all and everything was BS free. It can be hard to find professional service and that's what I received here. They were accommodating and honest.

reviews.author: Mark Doyle
reviews.text: ***Trained & knowledgeable mechanics who will take the time to thoroughly discuss issues with your vehicle. ***Confidence that when your repairs are complete "they were done right". ***Shop organization & housekeeping is top notch.

reviews.author: Christopher Baum
reviews.text: I honestly can’t say enough good things about this shop. From the moment I called, they were professional, straightforward, and genuinely helpful. It’s hard to find mechanics you feel you can truly trust, but these guys earned that trust very quickly.

reviews.author: Nancy Kopman
reviews.text: Found them brought AAA and Jim treated us like he would treat a good friend. Overhearing him on the phone helping his other customers, it is apparent that he treats everyone this way. The kind of treatment that restores your faith in human kindness.

reviews.author: Thomas Harris
reviews.text: like everyone else said its not cheap, but you do always get what you pay for. They will find and fix any problem fast and right the first time. No games here. They fix only what needs to be fixed, and more importantly don't break something else while fixing your problem like other more shoddy garages might, saving both time and money in the long run.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: Excellent service. Excellent workmanship. Honest advice and recomendations. Clean, modern, efficient. They keep their customers informed every step of the way. Reasonable rates. Professional establishment. This is what every business should aspire to be.

reviews.author: Annie L Velasquez
reviews.text: Took my car in for a wheel alignment. Car was done in less than an hour. Great customer service and friendly staff!

reviews.author: Kevin Grant
reviews.text: Absolutely the best..!! All work is explained in meticulous detail and in layman's terms. Skilled workers who definitely know their craft and make you feel welcome..!!Highly recommended..!!

reviews.author: Rob Mazzilli
reviews.text: Been going there for awhile. Very satisfied with the work. Good people. Honest. Would highly recommend this place. If you think they might be over priced, remember one thing. You get what you pay for. Clean facility.

reviews.author: Pablo Lamberto
reviews.text: I'm very unsatisfied by the service provided. It is very disappointing the irresponsibility of the workers when it comes to respect appointments. Never taking my car there again. Do not recommend.

reviews.author: Radar22
reviews.text: These guys are terrific ! They’re professional, knowledgeable, and advise you every step of the way as to what’s happening with the repairs. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Doug Kandel
reviews.text: Straight shooters. No upsells. Fair prices. Skilled mechanics. This is the shop I've been looking for!
